label: WRONG
reason: The admin blueprint is imported only by the app factory in CTFd/__init__.py to register it, which is how Flask blueprints work; no other file needs it, and the group even includes .eslintrc.js. Incidental, not a chosen boundary.

label: WRONG
reason: CTFd.cli is imported only where init_cli registers the _cli blueprint (utils/initialization/__init__.py); nothing else has a reason to import it, so the rule restates that the CLI is a leaf. Incidental.

label: WRONG
reason: CTFd.plugins holds the challenge and flag type registries (CHALLENGE_CLASSES, FLAG_CLASSES, get_chal_class), which admin, API, models and exports must import (admin/challenges.py, api/v1/flags.py, utils/exports/__init__.py). Other files don't because they don't deal with challenge types.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Management endpoints are @admins_only (audiences, awards, topics, tags, and Bracket post/patch/delete); the outliers are user-facing handlers guarded by @authed_only plus visibility checks (tokens, shares, solutions, unlocks) or deliberately public (BracketList.get, Hint.get). Every new handler should confirm its privilege level, so the warning is worth having; hesitated with WRONG legit_outliers, since user endpoints are a recurring category.
